desc:
🔴 Welcome to Prison Dodgeball! 🔵

Dodge. Throw. Survive. Escape Prison.

Pick a side — *RED vs BLUE* — and knock out the enemy team!

🏐 Get hit → You’re sent to **Prison** behind the enemy team.  
🎯 Catch a ball in Prison → Throw it at enemies from behind!  
🔓 Hit someone from Prison → *ESCAPE* and return to your team.  
⚠️ Watch your back — enemies can attack from BOTH SIDES!

Master your throws, dodge everything, and help your team take over the court.

Can your team dominate 🔴 Prison Dodgeball 🔵 ?
